authorityBoundary.sourceSelectionAuthority: mutable GitHub master and stored HTTPS credential

positiveControls: Root owns the script, units and credential file; credential file mode is 0600.
The script compares the last recorded revision with HEAD and avoids restart when equal.
A failed landmine check stops scripted restarts and leaves the recorded deployed revision unchanged.
Changed paths are considered across the deployed-to-new revision range for three named consumers.
The log demonstrates at least one historical landmine failure stopped service restart.

criticalFindings.finding: The controller pulls/checks /root, while effective Relay, bot and monitor units execute /opt/obsidian-exchange. It performs no copy, build, symlink switch or artifact promotion, yet can restart unchanged /opt processes and record /root HEAD as deployed.

Every 15 minutes an unsigned mutable master can enter a root-owned dirty checkout and execute repository Python during preflight, without pinned approved commit, signed tag, protected-branch evidence, artifact provenance or independent approval.
The checkout has 889 changed/untracked entries and no clean-tree gate. Tests run against a hybrid tree while state records only HEAD, so recorded revision cannot identify tested or running bytes.
Each is-active failure is consumed by an OR echo that succeeds; execution continues to write NEW_REV and Deploy complete. A failed or quickly crashing service may therefore suppress later retry.

Git pull mutates the source before checks, restarts are sequential, state is a non-atomic global text value, and there is no versioned release manifest, canary, automatic/manual rollback command or tested mixed-version recovery.

Only one Relay file is compiled plus one mutable custom landmine script. Dependency locks, migrations, config, systemd/Nginx, bot/monitor imports, full tests and many code-consuming services are outside the gate and impact map.
credential.helper=store keeps the HTTPS credential in plaintext. Any fetched code executed by the root pipeline can read it; read-only scope and independent rotation/revocation evidence are unproved.

The unit declares no sandboxing or capability limits, and a mode-0644 log receives test stdout/stderr. A separate legacy unit drop-in contains overridden inline sensitive material; its value was not read or copied into evidence.

independentReviews.finding: Unsigned mutable source, dirty root execution, plaintext credential, missing provenance and unrestricted host authority make the supply chain fail open.
Health failure can be recorded successful; rollout, state, coverage, locking, readiness, rollback and recovery are not reliable.
The controller updates /root but production executes /opt, while no operator status/approval/rollback surface exists.

rollout: none; the timer was observed but not invoked or changed
